title: Open Skeleton

clips.label: Happy
clips.description: A warm grin and a cheerful eye squint.

clips.label: Curious
clips.description: One raised lid, a questioning tilt, then back to you.

clips.label: Surprised
clips.description: A quick wide-eyed gasp, followed by recovery.

clips.label: Confused
clips.description: An uneven squint and a small reconsidering tilt.

clips.label: Concerned
clips.description: Soft eye contact and a sympathetic downward nod.

clips.label: Frustrated
clips.description: A narrowed stare and tense jaw, then release.

clips.label: Playful
clips.description: A deliberate wink with a crooked mechanical grin.

clips.label: Proud
clips.description: A pleased chin lift and a composed little smile.

clips.label: Relieved
clips.description: A slow eye closure and relaxed release of the jaw.

clips.label: Idle / blink
clips.description: A quiet presence, with an occasional blink.

clips.label: Thinking
clips.description: An upward glance, a pause, then back to you.

clips.label: Answering
clips.description: Short speech-like phrases, with pauses between.

description: Round ivory mechanical companion with exposed metal details and expressive gray-green eyes.

plannedActivities.label: Starting
plannedActivities.motion: Eyelids lift in two stages; eyes focus forward; small ready nod.

plannedActivities.label: Listening
plannedActivities.motion: Wider attentive eyes, small forward inclination and acknowledgment nod.

plannedActivities.label: Researching
plannedActivities.motion: Measured horizontal reading sweeps with short pauses and downward resets.

plannedActivities.label: Coding
plannedActivities.motion: Downward focus, short rapid eye movements, checking pauses and tiny decisive nod.

plannedActivities.label: Waiting
plannedActivities.motion: Patient side glance, slow blink and return to center.

plannedActivities.label: Needs input
plannedActivities.motion: Direct questioning gaze, one raised lid and a small tilted-head hold.

plannedActivities.label: Complete
plannedActivities.motion: A brief pleased expression and affirmative nod, then return to idle.

plannedActivities.label: Error
plannedActivities.motion: Short concerned surprise, brief hold, then attentive recovery pose.

plannedActivities.label: Sleeping
plannedActivities.motion: Slowly close both eyelids and incline head; hold still until waking.
